description: This Java source file defines the RegexValidatedTextDatatype class, which implements a custom datatype for validating strings against a regular expression in the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods for configuring the regex, serializing/deserializing the value, and validation logic to ensure the string matches the pattern.

classes.name: RegexValidatedTextDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for strings validated against a regular expression, extending SerializingCustomDatatype.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the regex pattern used for validation.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the input string; should fail if does not match regex.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string value; simply returns the input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input string matches the configured regex pattern; throws an exception if not.
